title: Nurse Faculty Pathways (sample NOFO)
subagency: Division of Nursing and Public Health
tagline: Helping schools of nursing grow and keep their faculty.

subsections.name: Basic information

Assistance Listing: 93.000 (sample)

Metadata subject: A sample NOFO that shows how NOFO content components appear on the web.

subsections.name: Summary
subsections.body: This program funds schools of nursing to recruit, prepare and keep nurse faculty. There are two application rounds; apply in the round that fits your timeline.
**Note for current recipients:** If you have an active award under this program, apply in the second round only.

subsections.name: Eligible applicants
subsections.body:
You may apply if you are one of the following:

  1. An accredited school of nursing.
  2. A health care facility that partners with a school of nursing.
  3. A state or local government that funds nurse education, including:
    1. State boards of nursing.
    2. Workforce development agencies.

Applicants in category (c)(ii) must include a letter of support from a school of nursing.

subsections.name: Get registered
subsections.body: Register with SAM.gov and Grants.gov before you apply. Registration can take several weeks.
